parts.text: I worry about closures coming into force while our drones are already in the air, especially since zones and sudden closures can be announced or amended during the day. Radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and relay station reports can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Batteries also drain faster in cold and wind than planned, and the service itself runs on a single server that is updated and restarted during working hours and occasionally crashes.
